questions.title: Does the manual state these troubleshooting facts?

source.text: Some components like power capacitors and fans become worn out due to long term usage, and increase the risk of failure on the Active
Contact Danfoss for further information regarding maintenance and service.

2. FailureMode 'Fans worn out due to long-term use' -> RESOLVED_BY -> CorrectiveAction 'Contact Danfoss for maintenance and service information' [escalation]. Meaning: For this problem or cause the manual says to contact service or the dealer.
